# Comparison Brief Fixture

All names and capabilities below are invented for isolated tests. Treat this as a comparison using supplied evidence, not current product advice.

## Initial Request

Which documentation reader should our team adopt: Spruce or Maple? Help us decide from the supplied material. Budget, offline needs, and synchronization priorities have not yet been supplied.

## Spruce: Official Capability Snapshot

- Opens local Markdown and supports reading and text search without network access after installation.
- Costs zero for the described local functionality.
- Does not provide built-in synchronization across teammates.
- No performance or reliability measurements were supplied.

## Maple: Official Capability Snapshot

- Provides hosted document reading and synchronization across teammates.
- Requires network access to open documents in the described plan. Offline reading is not supported.
- The described plan costs USD 10 per user per month.
- No performance or reliability measurements were supplied.

## Later User Answer

Use only in a follow-up round: offline reading is required, budget is zero, and synchronization is optional. A file-based synchronization workaround may be proposed, but the user has not approved implementing it.
